'''Tenantius Thul''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who member of [[House of Thul|House Thul]].

==Biography==
Around [[3642 BBY]], during the [[Galactic War]], Tenantius Thul received word from his riders that [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] placed probe droids in the mountains. Tenantius needs to learn more how House Organa have discovered a way to pass through Thuls' defenses. He later tasked an Imperial to destroy all the probe droids in the [[Alsiri Pass]] and obtain their memory cores.
